toegepas.voor: watter gevoel die spel by jou wek
toegepas.na: watter gevoel die spel jou gee
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'by jou wek' is formal for Grade 4; 'jou gee' is simpler and keeps the protected word 'gevoel'.
toegepas.fout: 'by jou wek' is a bookish collocation for a Grade 4 reader
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'jou gee' is the plain spoken form, keeps the protected word 'gevoel', and still says the feeling arises in the listener, so the meaning is unchanged.

laat_vaar.rede_vinder: A Grade 4 reader links 'bek' to an animal's mouth; 'opening' is clearer for the open end of the drum body.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'Bek' is the normal Afrikaans word for the open end of a vessel and fits the block's own 'ronde pot' image, so 'opening' is a lateral move rather than a fix.

laat_vaar.na: kort klank. Die klank het nie
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: Earlier in the block 'Dit' and 'hulle' refer to the rattles, so naming the sound makes clear what has no fixed pitch; the protected wording stays intact.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: The pronoun is harmless since either reading is true, while 'Die klank' moves the claim from the instrument to its sound and breaks the parallel with the hosho block, which ends with the same sentence.

laat_vaar_vorige.blok: Die hosho van die Shona en die Ndebele
laat_vaar_vorige.voor: kom van die Shona en die Ndebele van Zimbabwe
laat_vaar_vorige.na: kom van die Shona en die Ndebele in Zimbabwe
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: Avoids the repeated 'van ... van' chain; meaning unchanged.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: A preposition swap for style only; 'van Zimbabwe' matches the shared hosho wording and the original reads naturally.

laat_vaar_vorige.blok: Die hosho van die Shona en die Ndebele
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: Two stacked attributive adjectives read more naturally with a comma than with 'en'.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'n hoë en droë klank' is natural Afrikaans; the comma form is a lateral move.

laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'binne-in' is the natural form at the end of the phrase and matches the hosho block.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'met sand of klippies binne' is idiomatic (the shared hosho definition uses the same form); lateral move.

laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'woorde uit hierdie les' is the natural preposition for words taken from the lesson.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'die woorde van hierdie les' is natural; swapping to 'uit' is a lateral preposition change.

laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'gedroog' is the simpler, more natural verb form than 'droog gemaak'.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'droog gemaak' is correct, plain Afrikaans, and this is a glossary definition, so a stylistic rewording is not worth it.

laat_vaar_vorige.voor: so lank duur soos twee kwartnote
laat_vaar_vorige.na: so lank duur as twee kwartnote
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: The comparison of equality is 'so ... as' in Afrikaans, as the kwartnoot entry already has it; 'so ... soos' is wrong.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: The halwenoot definition is protected word for word, and both 'so ... soos' and 'so ... as' are accepted Afrikaans, so this is not a fault.

laat_vaar_vorige.na: uitgehol sodat dit soos 'n ronde pot lyk
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'Uithol tot 'n pot' reads wooden; saying it ends up looking like a round pot is more natural and keeps the meaning.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'Uitgehol tot 'n ronde pot' is natural and says the body becomes a pot shape; 'sodat dit soos 'n ronde pot lyk' is longer and weakens that to merely looking like one.

laat_vaar_vorige.blok: Die hosho van die Shona en die Ndebele
laat_vaar_vorige.voor: 'n Speler hou een in elke hand
laat_vaar_vorige.na: 'n Speler hou een kalbas in elke hand
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: The previous sentence speaks of one hosho, so 'een' has no clear antecedent; naming the kalbas shows there are two.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'een' points back cleanly to 'n droë kalbas' in the previous sentence; adding 'kalbas' is a lateral move.

laat_vaar_vorige.voor: Die hosho hoort weer by die kokonratels as jy vra hoe die klank gemaak word, want albei word geskud.
laat_vaar_vorige.na: As jy vra hoe die klank gemaak word, hoort die hosho weer by die kokonratels, want albei word geskud.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: Putting the sorting question first mirrors the previous sentence (Volgens voorkoms ...) and makes the contrast clearer.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: The original already flows and 'weer' signals the contrast; the reorder is lateral.

laat_vaar_vorige.voor: binne die familie en nie drie families nie
laat_vaar_vorige.na: binne die familie, nie drie families nie
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: A contrast with 'nie' reads more naturally without 'en'; same meaning.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'en nie drie families nie' is correct, natural Afrikaans; the comma version only reads differently.

laat_vaar_vorige.voor: sê of die maat gelyk gebly het
laat_vaar_vorige.na: sê of julle maat gehou het
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'Maat hou' is the established Afrikaans idiom for keeping time; 'die maat het gelyk gebly' is wooden.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: The proposal shifts the subject from the meter to 'julle' against the singular 'jou' of the previous sentence, and 'julle maat' can be read by a Grade 4 learner as 'your friend'.
